title: Tech Note: Query file integration in 4D
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: List box tabs for query management

historical_commentary.text: This note is built entirely around the classic Query Editor's JSON export format and the PROCESS 4D TAGS command for reconstructing and executing queries without the Query Editor UI; while this classic query-file mechanism still exists in 4D for backward compatibility, ORDA's dataclass query()/queryByFormula() methods and the modern query editor experience have become the preferred approach for building dynamic, saveable queries, making this note's core technique a legacy pattern today.
related_updates: ORDA introduced query()/queryByFormula() methods on dataclasses/entity selections that provide a more modern way to build and execute dynamic queries
The classic Query Editor and its JSON export format still exist for backward compatibility but are less emphasized in current documentation and new development
